cross-record linkage.detail: run, provider-response, transport-attempt, and tunnel-event hashes link locally

dedicated transport scope.detail: fresh HTTP connection, remote SOCKS DNS, scoped TLS exception, and anonymous-pipe bearer delivery

development-only source population.detail: source episodes=8; cases=64; no evaluation population loaded

dynamic schema integrity.detail: each response binds the frozen per-call legal target-slot schema

final tunnel cleanup.detail: one final cleanup event confirms process exit and listener closure

frozen semantic and transport input hash.detail: all frozen v1.2 semantic inputs and transport-only implementation inputs match

identical bounded retry policy.detail: every retry reused the exact request hash and at most one retry was allowed

information boundary and enum isolation.detail: violations=0; evaluator identifiers never enter model-visible enums

local credential redaction.detail: configured credential value is absent from every local experiment artifact

secret redaction.detail: configured API credential value is absent from all experiment files

separate bounded transport and semantic.detail: at most three identical-byte submissions, one transport replay, and two semantic attempts per logical call

static semantic-only action surface.detail: one purchased development artifact per call; no routing, execution, network tool, GitLab, or IDS action

transport accounting.detail: API submissions=128/384; provider responses=128; raw transport failures=0

wiseau pure network hop.detail: SSH uses -N/-T with no remote command; API environment names are stripped
